subject: pathology
title: Renal cell carcinoma, Wilms and urothelial cancer

steps.tx: **Renal cell carcinoma** (smoking, obesity, hypertension, dialysis acquired cysts) subtypes sort genetics: **clear cell** (**VHL** loss, hypervascular, commonest), papillary (MET, multifocal), **chromophobe** (Birt-Hogg-Dube, pale, best prognosis), collecting duct (aggressive). Classic triad (haematuria, flank pain, palpable mass) now rare; incidental imaging finds most. Treatment is **partial or radical nephrectomy** (cytoreductive debated) with **TKI and checkpoint inhibitors** (sunitinib, nivolumab) for metastatic; active surveillance suits small elderly masses.
steps.say: Hypervascular clear kidney mass is RCC: VHL lost. Small elderly masses watch; spread gets TKI plus immunotherapy.

steps.tx: **Paraneoplastic syndromes** flag RCC: **polycythaemia** (ectopic EPO), **hypercalcaemia** (PTHrP), hypertension (renin), **Stauffer syndrome** (nonmetastatic hepatic dysfunction with raised ALP), Cushing (ACTH), amyloid. New varicocele (left gonadal vein obstruction) or IVC thrombus warns locally advanced disease; lung cannonballs seed commonly. Paraneoplasia resolves with nephrectomy and recurs with relapse, serving as markers.
steps.say: New polycythaemia with kidney mass is EPO paraneoplasia. Left varicocele with haematuria is renal vein thrombus.

steps.tx: **Wilms tumour** (nephroblastoma, WT1 and WT2, triphasic blastemal with epithelial and stromal elements) presents as **painless abdominal mass** in toddlers that **crosses midline** (versus neuroblastoma which does not cross and calcifies with raised catecholamines); associations include **WAGR** (aniridia, genitourinary anomalies, retardation), Denys-Drash and **Beckwith-Wiedemann**. Treatment (vincristine with actinomycin and doxorubicin, nephrectomy timing by protocol) cures over 90 percent; **anaplasia** (p53) worsens needing intensification. Lung metastases resect.
steps.say: Painless midline crossing toddler mass is Wilms: chemo cures mostly. Aniridia plus mass is WAGR: delete WT1.

steps.tx: **Urothelial carcinoma** (smoking, **aniline dyes** and aromatic amines, cyclophosphamide, aristolochic acid, chronic schistosoma haematobium squamous) presents with **painless haematuria**; **carcinoma in situ** (flat high grade, BCG responsive) with papillary Ta/T1 graded low versus high. Non muscle invasive gets **TURBT with intravesical BCG** (live attenuated, cystitis with BCG sepsis caution); muscle invasive needs **neoadjuvant cisplatin with radical cystectomy** and diversion. Upper tract (renal pelvis, ureter) mirrors bladder with nephroureterectomy.
steps.say: Painless haematuria in a smoker is urothelial until scoped: TURBT stages. Flat red high grade is CIS: BCG.
